# Third-party assets

Vendored assets are served locally, without runtime CDN requests.

- Bootstrap 5.3.8: MIT, https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
- HTMX 2.0.8: BSD-2-Clause, https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx
- Lucide 0.468.0: ISC, https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- Manrope: SIL Open Font License, https://github.com/sharanda/manrope

License texts are included alongside the assets.
